title: Repetition over Diversity: High-Signal Data Filtering for Sample-Efficient German Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2604.28075v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent research has shown that filtering massive English web corpora into high-quality subsets significantly improves training efficiency. However, for high-resource non-English languages like German, French, or Japanese, aggressive filtering creates a strategic dilemma: should practitioners prioritize diversity by training once on large amounts of lightly filtered web data, or prioritize quality by strictly filtering for a high-quality core and repeating it over multiple epochs? We investigate this trade-off for German by applying hierarchical quality filters to 500M web documents, comparing multi-epoch training on filtered subsets against single-pass training on a diverse corpus. Our experiments across multiple model scales and token budgets show that repeating high-quality data consistently outperforms single-pass training on larger, less filtered sets. Notably, the performance gap persists even after 7 epochs. Our findings

translated_title: 重复胜于多样性：面向样本高效德语语言建模的高信号数据过滤
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，将海量英语网络语料库过滤为高质量子集可以显著提高训练效率。然而，对于德语、法语或日语等高资源非英语语言来说，激进过滤带来一个战略困境：从业者应该优先考虑多样性，即在大量轻度过滤的网络数据上进行单次训练，还是优先考虑质量，即严格过滤出高质量核心数据并在多个训练周期中重复使用？我们针对德语研究了这一权衡问题，将分层质量过滤器应用于5亿份网络文档，比较了在过滤子集上进行多周期训练与在多样化语料库上进行单次训练的效果。我们在多个模型规模和token预算下的实验表明，重复高质量数据始终优于在更大、过滤程度较低的集合上进行单次训练。值得注意的是，即使经过7个训练周期后，这一性能差距依然存在。
tldr: 该研究发现，对于德语语言建模，重复训练经过严格过滤的高质量数据始终优于在更大但过滤程度较低的数据集上进行单次训练，且这一性能优势在经过7个训练周期后依然保持。
en_tdlr: This study finds that for German language modeling, repeating strictly filtered high-quality data consistently outperforms single-pass training on larger, less filtered datasets, with the performance advantage persisting even after 7 epochs.
